finding.containment: This is surprising because the specialized road branch of عمل is not the ordinary meaning of `أَعْمَالَهُمْ`. It remains anchored in the exact deed-root, its immediate coexistence with `السَّبِيل`, and the final effort-to-ways sequence; prose should qualify it as a material analogy in which repetition wears a track, never translate “deeds” as “roads.”
finding.focus_anchor: `زَيَّنَ ... أَعْمَالَهُمْ` immediately before being barred from `السَّبِيل`.

changed_reading.before: Deeds and the path are separate: one is evaluated, the other is followed or abandoned.
changed_reading.after: Repeated adorned deeds may themselves wear an alternative behavioral track, while sustained striving opens and habituates different ways.
